extracted.subtask_description: An English Wikipedia article providing a comprehensive biographical encyclopedia entry on comedian Dave Chappelle; useful for readers and for editors maintaining/cleansing the article to meet Wikipedia standards.

rubrics_metrics.name: Section rewrite to meet Wikipedia quality standards
rubrics_metrics.description: "This section may need to be rewritten to comply with Wikipedia's quality standards, as it lacks cohesive textual flow. Relevant discussion may be found on the talk page. You can help."
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Flag indicates the section's prose should be reorganized and rewritten for cohesion and encyclopedic tone; editors are directed to discuss changes on the article talk page and to edit the article to bring the section into compliance with Wikipedia's quality standards.

rubrics_metrics.name: Neutrality of criticism/controversy sections
rubrics_metrics.description: "This 'criticism' or 'controversy' section may compromise the article's neutrality. Please help integrate negative information into other sections or remove undue focus on minor aspects through discussion on the talk page."
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Criterion: controversy/criticism material must not unduly dominate the article or violate NPOV. Guidance is to integrate negative/critical material into appropriate sections of the biography (rather than isolating it) or reduce undue emphasis; use talk-page discussion for disputes and restructuring.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use American English
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Style requirement for the article's language variety: use American English spelling and conventions consistently across the article.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use mdy date formatting
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Style requirement for date format: use month-day-year (mdy) formatting consistently in the article per the project's localization/style settings.
